bear_assumptions: USD 0.35 normalized per-share cash earnings at 18x plus USD 2.20 surplus cash; ARR growth slows, retention weakens, competition raises spending and dilution persists.
base_assumptions: USD 0.55 normalized per-share cash earnings at 24x plus USD 2.30 surplus cash; ARR grows near low double digits, gross margin stays resilient, operating discipline improves and buybacks broadly offset dilution.
bull_assumptions: USD 0.80 normalized per-share cash earnings at 30x plus USD 2.50 surplus cash; agentic orchestration sustains stronger growth, retention and margins while stock compensation falls as a share of revenue.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade the operative disposition only if fresh results sustain ARR growth, retention, profitability and per-share cash earnings while price and scenario asymmetry clear every economic and relationship gate; downgrade if growth, retention, margins, guidance, competitive position, agentic adoption, capital allocation, stock compensation, dilution, cybersecurity or AI-governance evidence deteriorates.
